items.item:
4. A symbolic link in the value area stops the start; one placed there after
   the start makes the store call that meets it fail with nothing written.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a18_symlink_in_data_dir_refused]
statements:
```text
processes_on(data_directory) <= 1
store_change -> one_call AND one_transaction IN store_module
file_published -> complete AND digest_verified AND never_overwritten
symlink_inside(data_directory) -> refused
```

verdicts.why: The selected test detects a symlink encountered by a store call, checks that the call fails without writing through or replacing the link, and checks that a symlink present at restart prevents startup; it also weakly checks that one previously published value remains complete. It does not assert the single-process limit, one-call/one-transaction store behavior, or the full digest-verified and never-overwritten publication guarantees.
